The case p=3 and both singleton-fiber boundary values are covered. The finite independent subset-DP verified every construction for p=3,5,7,11,13 and exhaustive completeness at p=3,5,7. Finitude is not substituted for infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The closest accessible primary texts establish the sharp length and a single standard two-term witness, but do not state the all-prime high-multiplicity inverse family or its (p-1)^2(p-2) count. Ordinary n-zero-free inverse results address a different predicate and a strict length range. The new claim is a nontrivial structural correspondence with maximal zero-sum-free sequences on C_p plus an exact support census. Absence from searches alone is not interpreted as proof of novelty; residual implicit-coverage risk remains.
residual_risks: An earlier classification may be implicit in general weighted or inverse zero-sum methods without using the same phrasing or numeric formula.

value.rationale: The sharp threshold and canonical witness naturally invite an inverse problem. The new reduction classifies all witnesses at every twice-odd-prime order with the extremal generator multiplicity; it identifies noncanonical mixed-order and three-supported witnesses and gives exact parametric counts rather than isolated arithmetic slices. No claim that all extremal sequences are classified; that remains open here.
